items.title: Cash Natural Gas Prices Head South Across the Map
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices retreated across most of the country Thursday, with Appalachia and West Texas among the hardest-hit markets, as persistently mild weather forecasts offered little encouragement for heating demand heading into November.

items.title: Natural Gas Bulls Find Little Shelter From Storage Surprise
items.summary: Natural gas futures extended their losses Thursday after a larger-than-expected storage injection broke a 10-week streak of below-average builds, adding to selling pressure that briefly sent the newly prompt December contract below $2.900/MMBtu.

items.title: Shell Sees LNG Growth Opportunities From Canada to Venezuela Amid Supply Crunch
items.summary: Following the acquisition of Canadian producer ARC and sanctioning of LNG Canada’s second phase, Shell management sees “multiple opportunities” for growth in a world facing severe energy disruptions.

items.title: Rio Grande LNG Nears Feedgas Milestone as Bay Runner Enters Service
items.summary: NextDecade expects to introduce natural gas into its Rio Grande LNG terminal before year-end, narrowing its first LNG production target to the second quarter of 2027 as commissioning advances.

items.title: Rising LNG Demand Cuts Into South’s Natural Gas Supply, Pushing Forward Curve Higher
items.summary: An increasing global need for US LNG and rising feedgas demand is helping to push forward prices higher in parts of the South, bucking a broader trend of shoulder season declines across most of the country.

items.title: DTM Moves on Midwest Plans as Natural Gas Demand ‘Measured in Bcfs’ Nears

items.title: Japanese Supply Deal Adds Commercial Support for LNG Canada Expansion
items.summary: Japan’s Kyushu Electric Power has reached a preliminary agreement to purchase 0.85 Mt/y from LNG Canada’s planned expansion, diversifying its supplies with Canadian cargoes expected to begin arriving in the early 2030s.

items.title: Plump Storage Build Sends Natural Gas Futures Slumping Into Midday Trade
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures struggled into midday on Thursday following a hefty government inventory print. Benchmark cash prices slipped as well.

items.title: QatarEnergy Expands US LNG Portfolio With 20-Year Woodside Deal
items.summary: QatarEnergy has agreed to purchase up to 3 Mt/y of LNG from Woodside Energy’s Louisiana LNG project, expanding its US supply portfolio as it seeks replacements for disrupted Qatari production.
